difficulty_reason: Countability criterion for being a hocolim of perfect complexes: (1)=>(2) via hocolim-cohomology commutation and local finite-free representatives of perfect complexes; (2)=>(1) via the DQCoh-is-Ddga equivalence: represent K and the perfect generator E by K-injective complexes, transport to the dg module M = Hom(I, K) with H^i(A) = Ext^i(E,E) and H^i(M) = Ext^i(E,K) computed in span, use that the equivalence commutes with hocolims, and finish with the dga countability lemma fed by lemma-countable-cohomology.
